brief: Kuwait: US streetwear brand Pacsun opened its first store outside the UAE at Assima Mall in Kuwait City (open since 15 Oct, launch event 22 Oct), after Mall of the Emirates in May and The Dubai Mall on 14 Oct.

Türkiye: Konyaspor plans 'Cadde 42', a low-rise, club-owned mall in front of Konya Stadium; Van Metropolitan Municipality is selling units at Van Mall AVM by tender on 2 Nov; and Fiba's İnegöl AVM says it won silver and bronze at the Solal Awards 2026.
Members: Knowledge Economic City will ask shareholders on 15 Nov to rename it Al-Jiwar Economic City, which would change the developer name on its Madinah listings.

AI agents: big US banks are restricting third-party AI agents, and JPMorgan bars them from moving money, the banking side of the shopping-agent split; in the UAE, the open Jais 3 models include Jais Speech, which transcribes dialects from 19 Arab countries.

2027 Directory: Cadde 42 goes to sheet 10 as Watch, GTC Mall in Nairobi (TimeVallée's first Kenya boutique) and Van Mall AVM as Check first, and Pacsun onto the Assima Mall listing; Q3 results and Q3 retail market reports have not started yet.

findings.company: Pacsun; release issued with Majid Al Futtaim's boilerplate
findings.title: Pacsun opens its first store outside the UAE at Assima Mall, Kuwait City
findings.summary: US streetwear brand Pacsun has opened its first Kuwait store at Assima Mall in Kuwait City. The store opened on 15 Oct 2026 and held its launch event on 22 Oct; it is the brand's third store in the region and its first outside the UAE, after Mall of the Emirates (its international debut in May 2026, with more than 5,000 visitors in its first three days) and The Dubai Mall (opened 14 Oct 2026). The release carries Majid Al Futtaim's boilerplate and gives no store size.
findings.why: An international brand chose Assima Mall for its first step beyond the UAE, after its debut at Majid Al Futtaim's Mall of the Emirates.

findings.title: Konyaspor plans 'Cadde 42', a club-owned, low-rise mall in front of Konya Stadium
findings.summary: Football club TÜMOSAN Konyaspor's board plans a shopping centre called 'Cadde 42' directly in front of Konya Stadium, beside the Anadolu Kartalı tram line, according to Mall Report. The design will be horizontal rather than high-rise, with a Konyaspor merchandise store, cafes and restaurants, and the income will go to the club. No investment, size, developer or construction dates were given.
findings.why: A club-owned, stadium-side mall is an unusual model and a new Türkiye pipeline candidate for the 2027 Directory once its size and timing are known.

findings.entity: Third-party AI agents in US bank accounts
findings.company: JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Morgan Stanley
findings.title: Big US banks restrict third-party AI agents, and JPMorgan bars them from moving money
findings.summary: Tom's Hardware, relaying an Axios report, said on 23 Oct that major US banks have detected AI agents accessing customer accounts and in some cases attempting transactions, and that Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo are blocking the technology and changing their terms of service, with some moving to read-only access. JPMorgan already lets outside agents such as Meta's Muse view some account data read-only but not send money or pay bills; Jamie Dimon told analysts on 13 Oct that the bank would not allow 'just any outside agent' in.
findings.why: This is the banking side of the split over shopping agents (Amazon and eBay block them, Walmart admits them): Gulf banks and payment networks face the same choice, and it will decide whether shoppers' AI agents can pay at Gulf retailers.

findings.title: İnegöl AVM wins silver and bronze at the Solal Awards 2026
findings.summary: Fiba Commercial Properties, investor and manager of İnegöl AVM in Bursa province, says the mall's 'Gelenekten Geleceğe' (From Tradition to the Future) project won silver in the Space Creation category and bronze in Corporate Social Responsibility at the Solal Awards 2026. It says the same project earlier won Hermes Creative Awards 2026, MarCom Awards 2025 and Stevie Awards 2025 honours. The release does not name the awards' organiser.
findings.why: A Turkish mall is publicising Solal wins in its home market; if these are MECSR's own Solal awards, it is a ready story for members and the awards' reach.

findings.title: Knowledge Economic City asks shareholders to rename it Al-Jiwar Economic City on 15 November
findings.summary: Knowledge Economic City (KEC) told Tadawul that shareholders will vote at an extraordinary general meeting on 15 Nov 2026 on amending Article 2 of its articles of association to change the company's name to Al-Jiwar Economic City Co. Argaam reported the notice on 22 Oct; no reason for the rebrand was given, and the change depends on the vote.
findings.why: If approved, the developer name on KEC's Madinah schemes in the directory, including Multaqa AlMadinah, and the member record will need the new name.

directory.change: After the 15 Nov 2026 vote, if approved, change the developer to Al-Jiwar Economic City on Multaqa AlMadinah, Knowledge Gardens and Wasat Al Madinah (if that entry is kept), using the English name in the Tadawul filing.

findings.title: Van Metropolitan Municipality puts units at Van Mall AVM up for sale by tender on 2 November
findings.summary: Van Metropolitan Municipality is selling independent units in the Van Mall AVM building in İpekyolu, including ground-floor units, together with two other properties in the Şerefiye neighbourhood, by sealed bid under Article 35 of Public Tender Law No. 2886, after a notice in the Official Gazette on 21 Oct 2026. The tender is on 2 Nov 2026 at 10:00; bidders lodge a 3% deposit, and mall units must be paid for in full within 15 days of approval. Mall Report lists areas and estimated values per lot, which should be checked against the Gazette notice.
findings.why: A publicly owned mall changing hands means a likely new owner and possibly a new operator for a Türkiye listing after 2 November.

findings.title: Swiss retailer TimeVallée opens Kenya's first multi-brand luxury watch boutique at GTC Mall, Nairobi
findings.summary: Swiss multi-brand luxury watch retailer TimeVallée has opened its first Kenyan boutique, with local retailer Art of Luxury, at GTC Mall in Nairobi's Westlands district. The boutique carries 10 brands, including Cartier, Bvlgari, Hublot, TAG Heuer, IWC Schaffhausen and Jaeger-LeCoultre; Capital FM gives its size as 300 square metres and Citizen Digital as over 300 square metres.
findings.why: International luxury retail is entering East Africa through a Nairobi mall that is not yet in the directory.

findings.company: MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models and Inception42
findings.title: Open Jais 3 Arabic models include Jais Speech, which transcribes dialects from 19 Arab countries
findings.summary: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models and Abu Dhabi's Inception42 have released Jais 3, a family of open Arabic language models, with Jais Speech, which transcribes Modern Standard Arabic and dialects spoken in 19 Arab countries, keeps English or French words in their original script when speakers switch language, and identifies the dialect. The developers say the largest model leads open models on agentic tasks and Jais Speech had the lowest average word and character error rates of the models compared, and they are publishing a suite of 24 Arabic benchmarks. Gulf News reported the launch on 15 Oct and The National followed on 24 Oct.
findings.why: Open, dialect-aware Arabic speech and agent models could cut the cost of Arabic voice bots and contact-centre AI for Gulf retailers, malls and service centres.

library.note: Landing page; the 12-page PDF linked there not opened. Survey of 139 senior executives across the six GCC countries (Aug to Sep 2025): 84% use AI in at least one function (62% in 2023), 60% use AI agents to some extent, 31% have scaled AI and 11% attribute at least 5% of earnings to it. No retail-specific findings. Older than six months but the current edition; background for AI sessions at RCM Jeddah and MECSC briefings.
